gaps.sentence: He denied ___ the vase, though the camera saw him.
The meeting was put ___ until Thursday.
I'd better not ___ you — you look busy.
I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).

gaps.sentence: By the time we arrived, the film ___ already started.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect for the earlier of two past events.

gaps.sentence: ___ of my parents speaks French, so I translate for them.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of' = not one and not the other (two people).
